def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise RuntimeError(message)

def run(name, command, cwd=game, expected_exit=0, timeout=30, clean=True):
    started = time.monotonic()
    completed = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
    check = {
        'name': name, 'command': [str(item) for item in command], 'cwd': str(cwd),
        'exit_status': completed.returncode, 'expected_exit_status': expected_exit,
        'elapsed_seconds': round(time.monotonic() - started, 3),
        'stdout': completed.stdout, 'stderr': completed.stderr,
    }
    record['checks'].append(check)
    save()
    require(completed.returncode == expected_exit, f'{name}: unexpected exit {completed.returncode}')
    if clean:
        require(not completed.stderr.strip(), f'{name}: unexpected stderr')
        require(not re.search(r'(?m)^(?:SCRIPT ERROR|ERROR|WARNING):', completed.stdout), f'{name}: engine diagnostic')
    print(f'PASS: {name} ({check["elapsed_seconds"]}s)', flush=True)
    return check

def events(check, event):
    return [item for line in check['stdout'].splitlines() if line.startswith('{')
            for item in [json.loads(line)] if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get('event') == event]

def assert_smoke(check):
    ready = events(check, 'server-ready')
    require(len(ready) == 1, 'Expected one server-ready record')
    require(ready[0]['build_revision'] == build_revision, 'Source identity mismatch')
    require(ready[0]['headless'] and ready[0]['display_server'] == 'headless', 'Graphical driver used')
    require(ready[0]['role'] == 'server' and ready[0]['audio_driver'] == 'Dummy', 'Wrong role/audio')
    require([item['iteration'] for item in events(check, 'server-heartbeat')] == [1, 2, 3], 'Heartbeats were not executed')
    smoke = events(check, 'server-smoke')
    require(smoke == [{'event': 'server-smoke', 'heartbeat_count': 3, 'result': 'Passed'}], 'No passing smoke')
    probes = events(check, 'server-bootstrap-check')
    require(len(probes) == 2, 'Expected startup and final scene checks')
    for probe in probes:
        require(probe['result'] == 'Passed' and probe['local_player_count'] == 0, 'Nonempty player tree')
        require(not probe['client_scene_loaded'] and not probe['unexpected_nodes'], 'Client or extra node present')
        require(probe['scene_nodes'] == ['/root/ServerRoot', '/root/ServerRoot/BootstrapHeartbeat'], 'Wrong tree')
    return ready[0]
